Hey Product Hunt 👋

We built OpenShip because deploying still feels like a stack of tools: a PaaS for git deploys, a panel for servers, scripts for rollbacks, and a lock-in problem if you ever want to move.

OpenShip is an open source platform for deploying apps on infrastructure you own or on OpenShip Cloud if you don’t want to run servers. [...] Self host is free and Apache-2.0. Cloud starts at $5/mo.

If you’ve been stuck between “easy but locked in” and “owned but painful,” this is the version we wanted.  
  
Try today: www.openship.io
